一剑绝代最新章节_前序第1页_一剑绝代火星上的蚂蚁_热点小说网
寒风冷送，四野静寂，天地之间，冰雪封盖。一阵箫声传来，如怨如诉，四处回荡。
寂寞的山巅，坐着寂寞的人，他的头发已被寒风拂乱，身体却依如钢铁一般，风夹着雪花渗入单薄的衣裳，他却毫无感觉，默默地吹着苍凉的曲子。
关门山惠泉寺内，主持苦禅大师刚念完一本般若心经，门外走进一名弟子，双掌合十道：“启禀师傅，弟子今天去送饭的时候，萧师兄让我转告你，他已经明白了那招剑法。”
苦禅大师睁开了眼，恍若从隔世中醒来，道：“好，很好！为师也该去看看他了。”
在一片旷地上，苦禅大师摘下一枚松针，对萧无恨道：“无恨，准备好了？”
萧无恨拔剑在手，对苦禅大师道：“大师，请！”
但见苦禅大师屈指一弹，一道青光飞出，直射萧无恨。忽然一道剑光划过，接着平静了，萧无恨站在那里仿佛一切都未发生，松针已分为两半，落在地上。
“这一剑你终于还是练成了。”苦禅大师若有所思地问道：“无恨，你来到这里已经十年了吧？”
萧无恨答道：“是的，大师，我在这里已经十年。”
苦禅大师接着道：“古语说‘十年磨一剑’，果然不错。我原和你约定，如果你一个月内无法参透这招剑法，便再呆上三年，想不到刚好一月，你就悟懂了这‘绝代一剑’。”
萧无恨道：“若不是大师十年来的苦心指点，无恨又怎能在一月之内悟懂这招剑法。”
苦禅大师道：“无恨，你在剑法上天分甚高，但对于俗世间的情感却无法放下。为师接你上山十年了，这十年，你的箫声怨气越来越重，杀气越来越浓，你父亲所希望的‘无忧无恨’恐怕只是无望了！”
萧无恨默然许久，望着天空道：“如果有一天我复了仇，即使死去，也是快乐的吧！”
“劫数，一切都是劫数！”苦禅大师道神色中含着一丝悲伤，道：“即如此，明天你就可以下山了。”
第二天一早，萧无恨前来辞别，苦禅大师领着一名弟子送行，望着萧无恨远去的身影，苦禅大师忽然流下一滴眼泪，身旁的弟子问道：“师傅，你是舍不得萧师兄吗？”
“不是，为师是担心他这一去是凶多吉少！”
“因为仇恨能让人清醒，也能让人糊涂；让人生若朗星，也能让人死若尘土；无恨的怨气太重了！”
“哎——”苦禅大师深深的叹了一口气，说道：“该要走得人，总是要走的，该要发生的，谁也无法阻止。无妄无真、不灭不生；有因有果，万法归宗。”

The cold wind blows, the fields are silent, and the sky and the earth are covered with ice and snow. A burst of flute sound came, like a complaint, echoing everywhere.
On the top of a lonely mountain, a lonely man sat. His hair had been ruffled by the cold wind, but his body was still as strong as steel. The wind carried snowflakes and seeped into his thin clothes, but he felt nothing and silently blew the desolate tune.
In the Huiquan Temple in Guanmen Mountain, the presiding Master Kuchan had just finished reciting the Prajna Heart Sutra. A disciple walked in outside the door, clasped his palms together and said, "Master Qi, when the disciple went to deliver the meal today, Senior Brother Xiao asked me to tell you that he has understood the sword technique."
Master Kuchan opened his eyes, as if waking up from another world, and said: "Okay, very good! It's time for me to go and see him."
In an open field, Master Kuchan picked off a pine needle and said to Xiao Wuhen, "Wuhen, are you ready?"
Xiao Wuhen drew his sword in his hand and said to Master Kuchan: "Master, please!"
But when Master Kuchan flicked his finger, a ray of blue light flew out and hit Xiao Wuhen directly. Suddenly a sword light flashed across, and then it calmed down. Xiao Wuhen stood there as if nothing had happened. The pine needles had split into two halves and fell to the ground.
"You finally mastered this sword." Master Kuchan asked thoughtfully: "Wuhen, it's been ten years since you came here, right?"
Xiao Wuhen replied: "Yes, Master, I have been here for ten years."
Master Kuchan continued: "The old saying goes, 'Ten years to sharpen a sword.' It's true. I originally agreed with you that if you can't master this sword technique within one month, you will stay for another three years. Unexpectedly, in just one month, you will understand this 'unparalleled sword'."
Xiao Wuhen said: "If it weren't for the master's painstaking guidance for ten years, how could Wuhen have understood this sword technique in one month."
Master Kuchan said: "Wuhen, you are very talented in swordsmanship, but you can't let go of the emotions in the world. It has been ten years since I took you up the mountain as my master. In these ten years, your flute sound has become more and more resentful and murderous. I am afraid that the 'no worries and no hatred' your father hoped for is just hopeless!"
Xiao Wuhen was silent for a long time, looked at the sky and said: "If one day I take revenge, even if I die, I will be happy!"
"Calamity, everything is calamity!" Master Kuchan said with a hint of sadness in his expression: "That's it, you can go down the mountain tomorrow."
Early the next morning, Xiao Wuhen came to say goodbye. Master Kuchan led a disciple to see him off. Looking at Xiao Wuhen's retreating figure, Master Kuchan suddenly shed a tear. The disciple next to him asked: "Master, are you reluctant to let go of Senior Brother Xiao?"
"No, my teacher is worried that his departure will be unlucky!"
"Because hatred can make people sober or confused; it can make people live like stars, but it can also make people die like dust; resentment without hatred is too heavy!"
"Hey -" Master Kuchan sighed deeply and said: "People are always going to go, and no one can stop what is going to happen. There is no delusion, no truth, no destruction and no birth; there is cause and effect, and all things return to their origin."
